<title Refills [G_refill] /> 4% of the magazine of Trace Rifles (rounded up) from reserves every 0.7 seconds. Works even while stowed.

Rapidly scoring 5 Trace Rifle hits on a <link Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Vehicle [#CombatantClassifications] /> marks them for you and allies for 10 seconds.

Additional hits refresh the mark duration. Does not require Direct Hits. Multiple people cannot mark the same enemy.

Only one target can be marked at a time and the mark cannot be transferred to a different target before the duration runs out or the enemy is defeated.

Ally kills on Marked Enemies spawn a <heavy/>Heavy Ammo Brick for allies and a <special/>Special Ammo Brick for you.

Spawned Ammo Bricks grant 10.33% of your total reserves (rounded up).
